title: Mailbox icon without target inbound (tools runner + prove Drift 1:1)
description:
## Symptom

Jack tells an agent to message another agent. Origin shows a **message icon** / Messaged @X chrome. The target agent's 1:1 (or channel) does **not** get the inbound. Drift stays empty; Cipher looks done.

Seen on localhost :3153 after lp-k5c4.16 (PR 720). BFF can paint origin notice without a tools-capable runner actually calling mailbox.send, or the hop enqueues and the target turn never lands in history/SSE (same turn-id collision / no-tools complete).

## Why

lp-k5c4.16 wired BFF hop chrome (origin system_notice, target enqueue source=mailbox). Acceptance still required a **tools-capable harness runner**. Local createEnvLiteLlmTurnRunner is **no-tools**. The model emits prose ("I messaged Drift") and the host may show icon chrome; Drift is not woken.

Plan 0019 D8 still holds: A2A = mailbox.send append + enqueue on the **target** thread. Not a second hop brain. Not a prompt that says "POST /api/...".

Cross-repo: lac-r9w owns mailbox.send tool runtime. Platform owns authorize, origin notice, enqueue, prove both rooms.

## Do not

- Give the model raw Portal HTTP routes to fetch
- Nested startTurn on the caller room (recursion / loop we already fused)
- Reopen mention-hop (lp-v62i.3.2 retired)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Tools-capable runner on the local/spine path (not no-tools complete)
- [ ] mailbox.send({to, room, text}) → origin Messaged @X notice AND target 1:1 history has source=mailbox inbound
- [ ] Jack "tell Drift X" / agent mailbox: Drift 1:1 is not empty; Drift can reply without Jack in Drift's composer
- [ ] Playwright: origin notice + target 1:1 bubble; no double-wake
- [ ] Fuse still applies (40/hour, ≤8 consecutive a2a, Halt)
acceptance_criteria: Tools-capable runner. mailbox.send paints origin notice AND target 1:1 has source=mailbox inbound. Playwright both rooms. No mention-hop. Fuse still on. No raw HTTP.
close_reason: Done. Branch beads/lp-k5c4.18-mailbox-runner commit 5c4f28c1 merged b22a5d7f. Mailbox tools runner: mailbox-send.ts with fuse 40/hour 8 consecutive, origin Messaged @X via applyMailboxHop, target 1:1 source=mailbox enqueue, nonce dedupe, Halt. Tests mailbox-send.test.ts 4 pass + mailbox-hop 13 pass on worktree; merged head wake-policy+group-inbound 40 pass.
